description: Finding: The startup guard at `crates/reader/src/main.rs` line 350-361 that aborts when `operator.signing_key_path` is unset on a non-loopback address uses the comment '// Enforce signing_key_path for non-loopback deployments (zn0k).' — no `// SECURITY:` prefix. The auth dev-mode guard two blocks later (line 363) does use the `// SECURITY:` prefix. Both imap and mail consistently mark their equivalent guard with `// SECURITY:`. The inconsistency makes it harder to grep for security enforcement points across the codebase. The comment should be prefixed with `// SECURITY:` to match the project convention.
title: reader main.rs signing_key guard lacks SECURITY comment
